hero.line: Leaf ground on stone, water at its point, a long pause.

manifesto.title: Quiet luxury
manifesto.p1: Luxury is not in the price, nor in who can pay it. It is in the experience: how something feels to the touch, to the hand.
manifesto.p2: It is matter and it is light. Cool stone, grained wood, the rising steam. Morning settling on green.
manifesto.p3: It is the balance between matter and light. Comfort, calm, tea drunk without hurry.
manifesto.quote: Lo que no es piedra es luz.

space.title: A tea room in Murcia
space.body: Tatami and warm wood. Handmade ceramics: chawan, chasen, chashaku. On the wall, a woven work. At the centre, a tree. Nothing more.
space.alt1: Lit timber shelving holding ceramic bowls.
space.alt2: The stone counter beneath a woven work.
space.alt3: The tree beside the timber lattice screens.
space.altMain: The salon: warm wood, tatami, the stone counter and the tree.
